ns2:course.label: Communication in Nutrition
ns2:course.description: Application and integration of the principles of nutrition and their transmission to groups and individuals. Students will learn individual counseling techniques as well as how to present nutrition information to groups. Open to Dietetics and Human Nutrition juniors and seniors only. Prerequisite: FSHN 220 or equivalent.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing. Restricted to BS:F Sc&Hum Nutrition-HN -UIUC or BS:F Sci&Hm Nutr-Diettcs -UIUC.
